purpose: JPEG and WebP encode and decode (lab-codecs) and AVIF decode (lab-avif) for Bitmap.compress, BitmapFactory and ImageDecoder: CanvasKit 0.42 has no JPEG/WebP encoder, applies EXIF orientation on decode and has no libjpeg DCT scaling

sources.name: libjpeg-turbo
sources.notes: built without SIMD (WITH_SIMD=0), 8-bit only, no TurboJPEG

sources.name: dav1d
sources.androidTracks: the AV1 decoder of Android's AVIF support (external/dav1d)
sources.notes: built with meson for wasm32, 8 and 16 bit pixel formats, no assembly, no logging, one thread

sources.name: libavif
sources.license: BSD-2-Clause (see licenses/libavif-LICENSE for the notices of the other files it carries)
sources.androidTracks: the AVIF container decoder of Android's AVIF support (libavif with dav1d)
sources.notes: decode sources only (no write.c), no libyuv, no libsharpyuv

sources.name: libwebp
sources.notes: encoder and decoder, no SIMD, no mux/demux/anim utilities

avifGlue.written: for the APK Web Lab: avifDecoderParse/NextImage and avifImageYUVToRGB to RGBA8888, one thread; irot/imir/clap are reported (transform flags), not applied

glue.written: for the APK Web Lab; encoder settings follow android-13.0.0_r1 external/skia src/images/SkJpegEncoder.cpp (jpeg_set_defaults, 4:2:0, optimize_coding, jpeg_set_quality force_baseline) and SkWebpEncoder.cpp (WebPConfigPreset DEFAULT; lossy method 3 YUV input, lossless method 0 ARGB input)

build.toolchain: Emscripten 3.1.74 (work/emsdk), -O2, MODULARIZE ES6, ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH, SUPPORT_LONGJMP=emscripten (libjpeg error recovery)

limits: ICC profiles are not written (Android 13 Skia embeds an sRGB profile in JPEG and WebP output)
CMYK/YCCK JPEG decode uses the Adobe-inverted convention only
animated WebP is not decoded here (CanvasKit decodes the first frame)
AVIF: 8-bit RGBA output only (10/12-bit sources are converted), irot/imir/clap not applied, first image only, no HDR/gain map; HEIF/HEIC is not available (HEVC decoders are LGPL or hardware)
